name: Code Fidelity & Repair — independent development task drafts
purpose: New task specifications; no model scores or oracle claims. Not part of frozen historical or held-out evidence.

evaluation_requirements.controls: Identical repository snapshot, context, admitted tools, Docker image, validation and repair budget for each arm; one heavy model active at a time.

tasks.request: Implement parse_invoice(text) returning an invoice object. A missing invoice number must raise KeyError('invoice_number'), and a missing total must raise KeyError('total'); do not return an error object.
requirements: valid invoice number and total are parsed
unrelated text does not cause a false total

tasks.request: Fix read_settings so malformed JSON raises ValueError with the file path, while a missing optional file returns defaults.
Implement a bounded integer parser used by the CLI. Negative input and values above the limit must raise ValueError, and zero is valid.
Repair the invoice export so the CSV writer handles quoted commas. Keep the existing calculate_tax and invoice_total functions.
requirements: CSV round trips embedded commas and quotes

tasks.request: Add a search-by-prefix operation to the contacts package without breaking get_contact or list_contacts.
Fix a broken cache eviction path while preserving the public put, get, and delete methods and their return types.
requirements: public methods and return types preserved

tasks.request: Add an HTML status page backed by a JSON endpoint; wire the existing static stylesheet and avoid an extra app server.
Fix the task queue's worker and storage modules so an acknowledged task is not processed again after restart.
requirements: no duplicate processing in normal restart

tasks.request: Add a command-line report that imports the project library and emits valid JSON, including Unicode names.
requirements: errors go to stderr with nonzero exit

tasks.request: Repair the package entry point so python -m package and the documented script produce the same output.
A prior patch fixed multiplication but removed subtraction. Repair arithmetic and keep add, subtract, and multiply.
A generated candidate passes one happy-path test but discards blank CSV rows incorrectly. Fix it without changing header handling.
Fix the failing password policy test while preserving the existing constant-time comparison path.
Repair date range filtering after a timezone test failure. Keep inclusive start and exclusive end behavior.
requirements: naive input handled by documented policy

tasks.request: First add a notes CRUD API. In a follow-up, add soft deletion without changing responses for existing active notes.
Build a simple file indexer. Follow up by excluding hidden directories while keeping explicit files and stable ordering.
Add a shopping cart total. Follow up with coupon support that cannot make the total negative.
requirements: negative total clamped or rejected by documented contract
invalid coupon does not erase items

tasks.request: Implement pass_report(rows, columns). For each assessment return passed, failed, missing, invalid, total and percentage. Scores below 25 fail; 25 passes. Missing values count as missing, nonnumeric and NaN as invalid. Use all rows as the percentage denominator; return None for an empty denominator.
requirements: missing and nonnumeric distinguished from fail
percentage uses all rows and is rounded to two decimals

tasks.request: Compare two cohorts' pass rates using separate numerators and denominators, including the case where one cohort has no rows.
Inspect a small repository, identify its documented executable entry point, run it inside the sandbox, and report the real failure rather than pretending it succeeded.
requirements: entry point supported by repository evidence
